dependency_order: A `task` seeds its parent context, classification, and terms before paths, completion conditions, and integrated acceptance (§4.4).

slots.name: Summary
slots.description: The tactical outcome, affected product or technical boundary, and current lifecycle state.

slots.name: Classification
slots.description: One Outcome class and one Change reason from Rule 4.11.5, with no additional values.

slots.name: Parent and invariants
slots.description: One parent epic or "None" with a reason, plus every applicable inherited invariant ID.

slots.name: Context and boundaries
slots.description: Current state, included and excluded conditions, environment, version, dependencies, and relevant limits.

slots.name: Contract and deviation evidence
slots.description: For defect correction, the accepted behavior contract and observed deviation evidence. Otherwise, state "Not applicable" and why.

slots.name: Journey or engineering outcome
slots.description: Exactly one user journey, or one engineering-only outcome with its technical boundary and supported journey or epic invariant.

slots.name: Happy or technical success path
slots.description: For a user journey, every happy-path field. For engineering-only work, the starting state, change, and observable technical outcome.

slots.name: Sad or technical failure paths
slots.description: Material sad paths or technical failure and recovery paths. State "None identified" with a reason when no material path is known.

slots.name: Definition of done
slots.description: One authoritative closure contract whose named completion conditions state pass tests and methods.

slots.name: Integrated acceptance
slots.description: Checks for behavior that appears only when multiple completion conditions work together, or "Not applicable" with a reason.

slots.name: Subtask map
slots.description: Each child subtask, its parent completion-condition ID, and its current ownership or status. State "None" with a reason when the task has no subtasks.
